{{- /* Inline a Tabler outline icon (https://tabler.io/icons, MIT) from assets/icons/tabler. Usage: {{ partial "icon.html" (dict "name" "cloud" "size" 40 "class" "my-class") }} Sizes follow the 8px grid: 16, 24, 32, 40 or 48. Icons are decorative (aria-hidden). */ -}} {{- $size := .size | default 24 -}} {{- $class := printf "icon %s" (.class | default "") -}} {{- with resources.Get (printf "icons/tabler/%s.svg" .name) -}} {{- $svg := .Content -}} {{- $svg = replaceRE `\s+` " " $svg -}} {{- $svg = replaceRE `width="24"` (printf `width="%d"` $size) $svg -}} {{- $svg = replaceRE `height="24"` (printf `height="%d"` $size) $svg -}} {{- $svg = replaceRE `class="[^"]*"` (printf `class="%s" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"` $class) $svg -}} {{- $svg | safeHTML -}} {{- else -}} {{- errorf "icon %q not found in assets/icons/tabler" .name -}} {{- end -}}
